gate: Gate 1 rung 4 (held-out witness system / held-out persona)

condition.name: A0-wit-nolen-capped
condition.note: CONTROL for the residual length channel that `drop_length` cannot reach: TF-IDF has no explicit length features, so dropping them is a no-op for it, yet a longer document still activates MORE terms after L2 normalisation. Truncating every witness side to a fixed token budget equalises that channel directly.

evalset_policy: empty-witness games DROPPED (silence is not a text property); same set in every cell
nesting: component holdout NESTED inside the system/persona holdout: train = (system != held) AND (component != held); eval = (system == held) AND (component == held). No eval game shares a witness system OR a participant with its training set.
